title: Season 2
overview: Matt Murdock and Wilson Fisk's escalating ideological conflict spills across New York City as new alliances and old grudges reshape the municipal landscape.

episodes.title: The Northern Star
episodes.overview: Matt Murdock confronts the municipal fallout of Mayor Fisk's aggressive administrative enforcement across Hell's Kitchen.

episodes.title: Shoot the Moon
episodes.overview: A daring high-stakes operation threatens to destabilize City Hall's new political framework.

episodes.title: The Scales & The Sword
episodes.overview: Legal arguments in court mirror fierce street confrontations as Nelson & Murdock take on a sensitive public case.

episodes.title: Gloves Off
episodes.overview: Vigilante activity intensifies when unexpected criminal syndicates exploit political turmoil.

episodes.title: The Grand Design
episodes.overview: Fisk's comprehensive vision for the future of New York faces pushback from grassroots resistance.

episodes.title: Requiem
episodes.overview: Tragic losses force both sides to reassess the personal costs of their prolonged ideological war.

episodes.title: The Hateful Darkness
episodes.overview: As the mayoral term hangs by a thread, secrets buried within municipal archives come to light.

episodes.title: The Southern Cross
episodes.overview: In an explosive season finale, Matt Murdock and Wilson Fisk clash in a decisive confrontation that determines the future of Hell's Kitchen.
